In the triangle shown, what is the value of $x$?
explanation: Choice D is correct. The sine of an angle in a right triangle is defined as the ratio of the length of the side opposite the angle to the length of the hypotenuse. In the given right triangle, angle $x$ is located at the bottom-right vertex. The side opposite to angle $x$ is the vertical leg with length $8$, and the hypotenuse has length $17$. Therefore, $\sin x = \frac{\text{opposite}}{\text{hypotenuse}} = \frac{8}{17}$.
